attributes.action: To be mandatory for all food providing  outlets to display food hygiene ratings
attributes.additional_details:
I am concerned that across our high streets  food hygiene standards are being misrepresented to the general public because there’s NO requirement to display a  food hygiene green & black standard label to the public. 

None of us really know if an establishment is a ‘1’ ( major improvement needed) or a ‘5’ - really very good standards. This is so unfair to those establishments working so hard to uphold standards and must be changed! These certificates MUST be displayed! 

Please support!
attributes.background:
Concern that food outlets working to achieve a  5 score are disadvantaged because there’s  no requirement for those getting a 1 score: major improvements needed  to show their score? 

This rewards poor standards & isn't acceptable. We don’t know where the poor outlets are as they don’t tell  us!

rejection.details:
You may wish to sign the following petition, which calls for similar action:

Make it a legal requirement to display Food Hygiene Ratings in England
https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/783879
